title.narrative: Providing critically important humanitarian assistance to the population affected by hostilities residing in close proximity to the front line and the border with the Russian Federation is essential.

description.narrative: ltpgtPeople who constantly live in the immediate vicinity of the front line and the border with the Russian Federation are exposed to danger every day due to shelling, as well as the possibility of infiltration by subversive groups. The situation in the mentioned territories is quite unstable, since the beginning of 2024, the intensity of shelling has increased significantly, a large number of enterprises have been closed, due to which the majority of the local population has lost their jobs and means of livelihood. Shops are also closed due to low purchasing power and danger. Thus, people are forced to risk their lives to reach other settlements in order to purchase the things they need for life.ltbrgtTse - nasha sprava! plans to provide assistance to 1,614 households located in the immediate vicinity of the front line and the border with the Russian Federation in the Kharkiv and Chuguyiv districts of the Kharkiv region and the Nikopol district of the Dnipropetrovsk region by distributing 1,380 hygiene kits, 200 NFI kits. and 272 warehouse meters of firewood. All sets are designed for 3 people.ltbrgtTse - nasha sprava! already carries out its activities in the specified territories, has well-established relations with local authorities, enjoys respect and authority among local residents. Yes, in Kharkiv Oblast, in settlements bordering the Russian Federation. Tse - nasha sprava! carried out repair works of private households, in the Chuguyiv district distributed hygiene kits, winter blankets, in the Nikopol district, mobile groups of the organization distributed PPE kits to beneficiaries affected by shelling within 72 hours.ltbrgtThe composition of the hygiene equipment is developed in accordance with the recommendations of the Wash Cluster, specified in the document: "2023 Review of WASH Cluster Recommended Hygiene Kits" and the indicators of the population's experience, which is our business! sanitary kits provided during 2022 and 2023. This set is designed for 3 people for 3 months and was approved by Wash Cluster.ltbrgtKits will be provided to the most vulnerable population (disabled, single mothers, large families, pensioners, unemployed, etc.) one kit per household, 408 kits in each declared district for 6 months.ltbrgtThe composition of the NFI kit has been agreed with the Shelter Cluster, the said kit will be provided to persons whose households have been affected by shelling. One set per household. Taking into account the intensity of shelling, the number of kits is distributed by location as follows: Nikopol district – 100 kits, Kharkiv district – 50 kits, Chuguyiv district – 50 kits. Since the distribution of these sets is scheduled for September - October, This is our business! allows for the possibility of changing the firing situation, so the number of sets can be redistributed.ltbrgtTse - nasha sprava! has a plan to distribute 272 warehouse meters of firewood for heating 34 households, 8 warehouse meters per household to the most vulnerable sections of the population (disabled, single mothers, large families, pensioners, unemployed, etc.) during September-October.ltbrgtTo determine the vulnerability factor, TNS will use an assessment in the form of cobo, thus the organization will achieve an independent assessment.ltbrgtMeanwhile, the entire project will be monitored by Tse - nasha sprava! specialists, beneficiaries will be able to leave feedback thanks to information brochures with communication channels.ltbrgtAt the end of the project, TNS will provide financial, descriptive and post-monitoring reports.lt/pgtltpgtlt/pgt
